talk.transcript: Today, we'll discuss the concept of metabolic rates. Metabolic rate is the speed at which your body converts food into energy. It varies from person to person based on several factors, including age, sex, muscle mass, and activity level. Higher muscle mass typically increases metabolic rate because muscle tissue burns more calories than fat tissue, even at rest. This means that individuals with more muscle can often eat more without gaining weight, as their bodies are constantly using energy. Understanding your metabolic rate can help you make informed decisions about diet and exercise.

options: The speed of food conversion to energy
questions.explain: 新陳代謝率是身體將食物轉化為能量的速度。
肌肉量增加通常會提高新陳代謝率。

options: They can eat more without gaining weight.
